name: Mercury
description: Mercury is the smallest planet in our Solar System and the closest planet to the Sun. It has a rocky surface and almost no atmosphere.
fact: Mercury completes one orbit around the Sun in just 88 Earth days.

name: Venus
description: Venus has a thick atmosphere rich in carbon dioxide. Its powerful greenhouse effect makes it the hottest planet in our Solar System.
fact: Venus rotates so slowly that its day is longer than its year.

name: Earth
description: Earth is our home planet and the only world currently known to support life. Its liquid water and protective atmosphere make it unique.
fact: Earth is the only planet currently known to support life.

name: Mars
description: Mars is known as the Red Planet because iron minerals in its soil create a rusty colour. Scientists study it for evidence of ancient water and possible past life.
fact: Mars contains Olympus Mons, one of the largest volcanoes in the Solar System.

name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System. It is a gas giant famous for its enormous storms, including the Great Red Spot.
fact: Jupiter is so massive that all the other planets could fit inside it by volume.

name: Saturn
description: Saturn is a gas giant best known for its spectacular rings, made mainly of countless pieces of ice and rocky material.
fact: Saturn's average density is lower than that of water.

name: Uranus
description: Uranus is an ice giant with a blue-green appearance caused by methane in its atmosphere. It rotates on an extreme tilt.
fact: Uranus rotates on its side compared with most other planets.

name: Neptune
description: Neptune is the farthest recognised planet from the Sun. It is an ice giant with a deep blue atmosphere and extremely fast winds.
fact: Neptune takes about 165 Earth years to orbit the Sun.
